check.title: Prayer Time
check.text: Have you prayed? You can continue your activities or take a prayer break and come back.

break.title: Prayer break
break.text: Take your time. Your mission is saved, and you can continue when you return.
break.lengthQ: Want a reminder? Pick how long.
break.reminderOnly: This is just a reminder. Close the app if you like, and come back whenever you're ready.
break.notifNote: If your device allows notifications, you'll get one when the time is up.
break.welcome: Welcome back. Shall we continue where we left off?
break.upText: Your break reminder has finished. No rush.
break.rowUp: Prayer break · your reminder is up

noTimes: Prayer times can't be calculated for this place. Choose a city instead.
sunrise: Sunrise {{time}}. Shown for reference; it isn't one of the five prayers.

setup.title: Prayer Times for Your City
setup.text: We can show prayer times and help schedule your activities around them. Would you like to choose a city or use your location?
setup.why: We'll use your location once to calculate prayer times on your phone. It isn't sent anywhere, we keep it rounded to about 1 km, and you can remove it any time.
setup.noMatch: No city matches. Try another spelling.

err.denied: Location permission was turned off. You can choose your city instead.
err.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Try again, or choose your city.
err.unavailable: Your location isn't available right now. You can choose your city instead.
err.insecure: Location only works on a secure connection. Choose your city instead.
err.unsupported: This device can't share its location. Choose your city instead.

settings.onNote: Shows prayer times and offers a check-in at prayer time. Turning it off removes your saved city, location and answers.
settings.flashOff: Turned off. Your city, location and answers were removed
settings.calcNote: Calculated on your device with {{method}}. Nothing is sent anywhere. Times can differ from your mosque by a minute or two.
settings.methodNote: Umm al-Qura is the default in Saudi Arabia. Pick the one your community follows.
settings.protectNote: How long after each call to prayer the check-in can appear.
settings.askNote: On: at prayer time we ask once, and you choose to continue or take a break. Off: no prompts, ever.
